title: Bell violation with path-entangled number states under realistic detection
summary: A single photon delocalised over two modes is entangled, and whether that entanglement can violate a Bell inequality has been disputed for three decades. In principle it is settled: the surviving objection was the absence of a shared phase reference, and a local oscillator supplies one, acting as a shared frame rather than as a measurement setting. In practice it is open, and what remains is a question about the apparatus.
